{{- /* Load active comment system scripts (title-case names) */ -}} {{- $c := .Site.Params.comments | default dict -}} {{- $use := $c.use | default slice -}} {{- if reflect.IsSlice $use | not }}{{ if $use }}{{ $use = slice $use }}{{ else }}{{ $use = slice }}{{ end }}{{ end -}} {{- $norm := slice -}} {{- range $use }}{{ $norm = $norm | append (. | title) }}{{ end -}} {{- range $name := $norm }} {{- if eq $name "Giscus" }} {{ partial "third-party/comments/giscus.html" $ }} {{- else if eq $name "Twikoo" }} {{ partial "third-party/comments/twikoo.html" $ }} {{- else if eq $name "Waline" }} {{ partial "third-party/comments/waline.html" $ }} {{- else if eq $name "Valine" }} {{ partial "third-party/comments/valine.html" $ }} {{- else if eq $name "Artalk" }} {{ partial "third-party/comments/artalk.html" $ }} {{- end }} {{- end }}
